Pattern.Intent: Default shape per inherited `AX_ONE_UNIFIED_CONTEXT_PER_FILE` + `AX_PREFER_FACTORY_OVER_HOOKS`: ONE context type + ONE factory for the whole file. Two cases differ only by factory overrides, not by structure.
Pattern.Why: One context type, one factory; failure case overrides exactly one field and reuses everything else. No describe-scope `let`s; stubs flow through injection seams; no module-level mocks. One-line SETUP and TRIGGER → no anchors; multi-line ASSERT → anchored.
